items.informal_name: Siegel's Lemma: Existence of Small Integer Solutions
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] (A : Matrix α β ℤ),
  Fintype.card α < Fintype.card β →
    0 < Fintype.card α →
      ∃ t,
        t ≠ 0 ∧
          A.mulVec t = 0 ∧
            ‖t‖ ≤ (↑(Fintype.card β) * max 1 ‖A‖) ^ (↑(Fintype.card α) / (↑(Fintype.card β) - ↑(Fintype.card α)))
items.informal_description: Given an integer matrix $ A $ with $ n $ rows and $ m $ columns where $ n < m $, there exists a non-zero integer vector $ \mathbf{t} $ such that $ A \mathbf{t} = 0 $ and the sup-norm $ \|\mathbf{t}\| $ satisfies $ \|\mathbf{t}\| \leq \left(n \cdot \max(1, \|A\|)\right)^{m / (n - m)} $.

items.informal_description: There exists a non-zero vector $\xi$ in the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$ of a number field $K$ such that $a \cdot \xi = 0$ and for every embedding $\varphi$, the absolute value $|\varphi(\xi_l)|$ is bounded above by $c_1(K) \cdot (c_1(K) \cdot q \cdot A)^{p/(q - p)}$, where $c_1(K)$ is a constant depending on $K$, and $p, q, A$ are parameters.

items.informal_name: Norm Bound in Class Group for Euclidean Domains
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {S : Type u_2} →
    [inst : EuclideanDomain R] →
      [inst_1 : CommRing S] →
        [IsDomain S] →
          [inst_3 : Algebra R S] →
            AbsoluteValue R ℤ → {ι : Type u_5} → [DecidableEq ι] → [Fintype ι] → Module.Basis ι R S → ℤ
items.informal_description: Given a Euclidean domain $ R $, a commutative domain $ S $ with an $ R $-algebra structure, and a finite basis $ b_S $ for $ S $ over $ R $, let $ n $ be the cardinality of the index set $ \iota $ for the basis. Let $ m $ be the maximum absolute value of entries in the left multiplication matrix representation of $ b_S $. The norm bound is defined as $ n! \cdot (n \cdot m)^n $, where $ n! $ denotes the factorial of $ n $. This integer bound arises from combinatorial and matrix norm considerations in the class group context.

items.informal_name: Positivity of the Norm Bound for Z-Lattices
items.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  {L : Submodule ℤ E} [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] {ι : Type u_3} (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L), 0 < ZLattice.normBound b
items.informal_description: For any basis $ b $ of the $ \mathbb{Z} $-lattice $ L $, the norm bound $ \varepsilon $ associated with $ b $ satisfies $ \varepsilon > 0 $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient Absolute Value Bound in Z-Lattice from Norm Inequality
items.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  {L : Submodule ℤ E} [inst_3 : DiscreteTopology ↥L] {ι : Type u_3} (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L) (x : ↥L) (n : ℕ),
  ‖x‖ < ZLattice.normBound b * ↑n → ∀ (i : ι), |(b.repr x) i| < ↑n
items.informal_description: For any element $ x $ in a $ \mathbb{Z} $-lattice $ L $ with basis $ b $, if the norm $ \|x\| $ satisfies $ \|x\| < \varepsilon \cdot n $ where $ \varepsilon $ is the norm bound of $ b $ and $ n $ is a natural number, then the absolute value of each coefficient $ |\text{coeff}_i(x)| $ in the basis $ b $ is strictly less than $ n $.

items.type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] →
    [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] →
      [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] → {L : Submodule ℤ E} → [DiscreteTopology ↥L] → {ι : Type u_3} → Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥L → ℝ
items.informal_description: The function assigns to each basis $ b $ of the $ \mathbb{Z} $-lattice $ L $ a positive real number $ \varepsilon $ such that for every element $ x \in L $ and every basis index $ i $, the inequality $ \varepsilon \cdot |\text{coeff}_i(x)| \leq \|x\| $ holds, where $ \text{coeff}_i(x) $ denotes the $ i $-th coefficient of $ x $ in the basis $ b $ and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the norm on $ L $.

items.informal_name: Existence of Non-Zero Algebraic Integer with Bounded Norm in Number Field under Convex Body Volume Condition
items.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {B : ℝ},
  NumberField.mixedEmbedding.minkowskiBound K 1 ≤ MeasureTheory.volume (NumberField.mixedEmbedding.convexBodySum K B) →
    ∃ a, a ≠ 0 ∧ ↑|(Algebra.norm ℚ) ↑a| ≤ (B / ↑(Module.finrank ℚ K)) ^ Module.finrank ℚ K
items.informal_description: Let $ K $ be a number field with ring of integers $ \mathcal{O}_K $, and let $ B $ be a positive real number. If the Minkowski bound $ \text{minkowskiBound}(K, 1) $ is less than or equal to the volume of the convex body $ \text{convexBodySum}(K, B) $, then there exists a non-zero element $ a \in \mathcal{O}_K $ such that the absolute value of the field norm $ \text{Norm}_{K/\mathbb{Q}}(a) $ satisfies $ |\text{Norm}_{K/\mathbb{Q}}(a)| \leq \left(\frac{B}{[K : \mathbb{Q}]}\right)^{[K : \mathbb{Q}]} $.
